revert.alreadyLinked: {{wallet}} is already linked to account {{account}}. Unlink it there first.
revert.notLinked: {{wallet}} is not linked here (only its account, or the wallet itself, can unlink it).
revert.tooManyWallets: This account already has the maximum of 8 linked wallets.
revert.expired: The signature has expired — sign the link again from the spending wallet.
revert.badSignature: The link signature did not verify. It may name a different account, or the wallet's nonce moved since it was signed — sign it again. If the spending wallet is a smart wallet that has never sent a transaction on Robinhood Chain, it is not deployed yet and its signature cannot verify: send one transaction from it first (e.g. Authorize round-ups), then sign again.
revert.zeroLeg: {{symbol}} has a 0% weight — remove it or give it weight.
revert.ineligibleAsset: {{symbol}} is not active in the asset registry, so it cannot be elected.
revert.unknownAsset: {{symbol}} is not in the asset registry.
revert.oracleNotOk: The price oracle is {{status}} — try again when it is live.
revert.outsideBand: The pool price moved outside the allowed band.
revert.ruleDisabled: Round-ups are disabled for this account (rule off or weekly cap 0).
revert.weeklyCapExceeded: That would exceed the weekly cap ({{amount}} > {{cap}}).
revert.cursorNotAdvancing: That block range was already accrued.
revert.notFinal: That block range is not final yet.
revert.allowanceExpired: The Permit2 allowance has expired — authorize round-ups again.
revert.insufficientAllowance: The Permit2 allowance is too low — authorize round-ups again.
revert.isPaused: SPARE is paused by its operator — new activity is halted. Exits and claims still work.
revert.notKeeper: Only the SPARE keeper can do that.
revert.notPauser: Only the SPARE pauser can do that.
revert.notExecutor: Only the SweepExecutor can do that.
revert.notOwner: Only the contract owner can do that.

errors.rejected: You rejected the request in your wallet — nothing was sent.
errors.noGas: Not enough ETH on Robinhood Chain to pay for gas.

fundErrors.tooLittleReceived: The price moved: this swap would pay you {{got}}, below your minimum of {{min}}. Nothing was swapped — refresh the quote or allow more slippage.
fundErrors.pastPriceLimit: The pool price is past the swap's price limit — nothing was swapped.
fundErrors.deadlinePassed: The swap's 10-minute deadline passed before it landed — nothing was swapped. Start it again.
fundErrors.stepFailed: Step {{step}} of the router call failed — nothing was swapped.
fundErrors.poolRejected: The pool rejected the swap — nothing was swapped.
fundErrors.allowanceExpired: The Uniswap router has no live Permit2 allowance for your USDG — start the swap again and approve when your wallet asks.
fundErrors.allowanceLow: The Permit2 allowance for the Uniswap router is below the swap amount — start the swap again to approve the exact amount.
fundErrors.nonceUsed: That Permit2 signature was already used — start the swap again.
fundErrors.signatureExpired: The Permit2 signature expired — start the swap again.
fundErrors.noEth: The router did not receive the ETH for this swap — nothing was swapped.
fundErrors.notSettled: The swap did not settle (balance or allowance too low) — nothing was swapped.
fundErrors.outsideLimit: The pool price is outside the swap's limit — nothing was swapped.
fundErrors.pullFailed: Permit2 could not pull your USDG — check your USDG balance and try again.
fundErrors.transferFailed: The token transfer failed — nothing was swapped.
fundErrors.panic: The contract panicked (code {{code}}) — nothing was swapped.

fundGuard.noQuote: The pool quoted nothing for this amount — swap blocked.
fundGuard.noProbe: Could not price a small reference trade in the same pool — swap blocked until it can be checked.
fundGuard.impact: This amount moves the pool price {{pct}} against you (vs a tiny trade) — swap blocked to protect you. Try a smaller amount.
fundGuard.noRef: Chainlink’s ETH/USD reference price is unavailable, so the pool price cannot be checked — swap blocked until it can be read.
fundGuard.staleRef: Chainlink’s ETH/USD price is {{age}} old (it updates at least every {{hours}} h) — swap blocked until it updates.
fundGuard.belowRef: The pool pays {{pct}} less than Chainlink’s ETH/USD price — swap blocked to protect you. Try a smaller amount or later.
fundGuard.noUsablePrice: Chainlink ETH/USD returned no usable price — swap blocked.

changelog.deployed: Spare contracts deployed on Robinhood Chain mainnet (blocks 76,221,503–76,221,683).
changelog.review: Security-review fixes: keeper-only, quote-limited sweeps; every swap failure defers; rolling 7-day cap; exit pays pending USDG first.
changelog.pools: At launch: NVDA pinned to the hookless 0.01% pool; QQQ and SGOV registered inactive.
changelog.universe: The full Robinhood Chain stock universe registered: every tokenized stock with a Chainlink feed. A stock is live while its pinned pool tracks Chainlink and waits on standby otherwise. SPY re-pinned to its 0.05% pool; SGOV live on a hookless pool.
changelog.fund: Fund Wallet: ETH ↔ USDG with a 0.25% fee.

standby.pool: On standby: registered, but not active yet, so it can't be picked or bought.
standby.noQuote: On standby: its pinned pool returns no quote right now.
standby.fillOutside: On standby: $100 through its pinned pool buys {{pct}} fewer tokens than Chainlink's price, outside the {{band}} oracle band.
standby.fillThin: On standby: $100 through its pinned pool buys {{pct}} fewer tokens than Chainlink's price, past Spare's {{bar}} activation bar.
standby.fillOk: On standby: its pinned pool fills within {{pct}} of Chainlink at $100 right now; turning it on is the owner's call.
